mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(1) FROM CSH_WRITE_OFF CWO WHERE (CWO.REVERSED_FLAG ='N' OR CWO.REVERSED_FLAG IS NULL) AND CWO.CSH_TRANSACTION_ID=#{cshTransactionId}

SELECT cwo.write_off_doc_category as writeOffDocCategory, ct.transaction_id as cshTransactionId, cwo.write_off_id as writeOffId, ct.transaction_amount as transactionAmount, ct.description as description, ct.bank_slip_num as bankSlipNum, ct.payment_method as paymentMethod, (select scvb.meaning from sys_code_value_b scvb , sys_code_b scb where scvb.CODE_ID = scb.CODE_ID and scb.code= 'CSH.PAYMENT_METHOD' and scvb.value = ct.payment_method) as payment_method_name, cwo.write_off_date as writeOffDate, cwo.write_off_due_amount as writeOffDueAmount, nvl(cwo.write_off_interest,0) as writeOffInterest, nvl(cwo.write_off_principal,0) as writeOffPrincipal, cwo.contract_id as contractId, cwo.cashflow_id as cashflowId, cc.contract_number as contractNumber, cwo.times as times, nvl(cwo.write_off_interest,0) write_off_interest, nvl(cwo.write_off_principal,0) write_off_principal, ccc.cf_direction as cfDirection, cwo.write_off_type as writeOffType, (select scvb.meaning from sys_code_value_b scvb , sys_code_b scb where scvb.CODE_ID = scb.CODE_ID and scb.code= 'CSH.WRITE_OFF_TYPE' and scvb.value = cwo.write_off_type) as write_off_type_name, -- 核销类型 cwo.cf_item as cfItem, hci.description AS cf_item_name FROM csh_transaction ct, csh_write_off cwo LEFT OUTER JOIN con_contract_cashflow ccc on cwo.cashflow_id = ccc.cashflow_id LEFT OUTER JOIN con_contract cc on cwo.contract_Id = cc.contract_id left OUTER join hls_cashflow_item hci on cwo.cf_item = hci.cf_item WHERE
ct.transaction_id = #{transactionId} AND
cwo.csh_transaction_id = ct.transaction_id and cwo.write_off_type in ('PAYMENT_DEBT','RECEIPT_CREDIT') AND ct.reversed_flag = 'N' AND cwo.reversed_flag = 'N' UNION
SELECT cwo.write_off_doc_category as writeOffDocCategory, ct.transaction_id as cshTransactionId, cwo.write_off_id as writeOffId, ct.transaction_amount as transactionAmount, ct.description as description, ct.bank_slip_num as bankSlipNum, ct.payment_method as paymentMethod, (select scvb.meaning from sys_code_value_b scvb , sys_code_b scb where scvb.CODE_ID = scb.CODE_ID and scb.code= 'CSH.PAYMENT_METHOD' and scvb.value = ct.payment_method) as payment_method_name, cwo.write_off_date as writeOffDate, cwo.write_off_due_amount as writeOffDueAmount, nvl(cwo.write_off_interest,0) as writeOffInterest, nvl(cwo.write_off_principal,0) as writeOffPrincipal, cwo.contract_id as contractId, cwo.cashflow_id as cashflowId, cc.contract_number as contractNumber, cwo.times as times, nvl(cwo.write_off_interest,0) write_off_interest, nvl(cwo.write_off_principal,0) write_off_principal, ccc.cf_direction as cfDirection, cwo.write_off_type as writeOffType, (select scvb.meaning from sys_code_value_b scvb , sys_code_b scb where scvb.CODE_ID = scb.CODE_ID and scb.code= 'CSH.WRITE_OFF_TYPE' and scvb.value = cwo.write_off_type) as write_off_type_name, -- 核销类型 cwo.cf_item as cfItem, hci.description AS cf_item_name FROM csh_transaction ct, csh_write_off cwo LEFT OUTER JOIN fct_quotation_cashflow ccc on cwo.cashflow_id = ccc.quotation_cashflow_id LEFT OUTER JOIN fct_contract cc on cwo.contract_Id = cc.contract_id left OUTER join hls_cashflow_item hci on cwo.cf_item = hci.cf_item WHERE
ct.transaction_id = #{transactionId} AND
cwo.csh_transaction_id = ct.transaction_id and cwo.write_off_type in ('CT_FCT_PAYMENT_DEBT','CT_FCT_RECEIPT_CREDIT') AND ct.reversed_flag = 'N' AND cwo.reversed_flag = 'N'
mapper.update: UPDATE con_contract_cashflow csh SET csh.received_amount = nvl(csh.received_amount,0) + #{cshWriteOffAmount}, csh.received_principal = nvl(csh.received_principal,0) + #{writeOffPrincipal}, csh.received_interest = nvl(csh.received_interest,0) + #{writeOffInterest}, csh.write_off_flag = #{writeOffFlag}, csh.last_received_date = #{lastReceiveDate}, csh.full_write_off_date = #{fullWriteOffDate} WHERE csh.cashflow_id = #{cashflowId}
mapper.select: SELECT cwo.*, ct.penalty_calc_date FROM csh_write_off cwo, csh_transaction ct WHERE cwo.csh_transaction_id = ct.transaction_id and cwo.reversed_flag = 'N' and cwo.cashflow_id = #{cashflowId} and ct.transaction_date > #{dueDate}

SELECT cwo.*, ct.penalty_calc_date FROM csh_write_off cwo, csh_transaction ct WHERE cwo.csh_transaction_id = ct.transaction_id and cwo.reversed_flag = 'N' and cwo.cashflow_id = #{cashflowId} and ct.penalty_calc_date <= #{dueDate}
mapper.update: update csh_write_off wo set wo.reversed_flag = #{reversedFlag,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, wo.reversed_write_off_id = #{subWriteOffId,jdbcType=BIGINT}, wo.reversed_date = #{reversedDate,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, wo.LAST_UPDATED_BY = #{userId,jdbcType=BIGINT}, wo.LAST_UPDATE_DATE = #{date,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP} where wo.write_off_id = #{writeOffId,jdbcType=BIGINT}

UPDATE con_contract_cashflow ccc SET ccc.received_amount = #{receivedAmount}, ccc.received_principal = #{receivedPrincipal}, ccc.received_interest = #{receivedInterest}, ccc.write_off_flag = #{writeOffFlag}, ccc.last_received_date = #{lastReceivedDate}, ccc.full_write_off_date = #{fullWriteOffDate} WHERE ccc.cashflow_id = #{cashflowId}
mapper.select: select t.*, /*未到期：未还、部分还---01还款中；足额还---04已提还； 应收日当天：未还、部分还---01还款中；足额还款---03还款完毕； 到期后：未还，部分还---02已逾期；足额还款---05逾期完成；*/ case t.write_off_flag when 'FULL' then case when trunc(t.due_date )> trunc(t.max_WRITE_OFF_DATE) THEN '04' when trunc(t.due_date )= trunc(t.max_WRITE_OFF_DATE) THEN '03' else '05' end else case when trunc(t.due_date )>= trunc(sysdate) THEN '01' else '02' end end as flow_status from ( select CT.Flow_No, cash.write_off_flag, nvl(w.write_off_principal, 0) AS write_off_principal, nvl(w.write_off_interest, 0) AS write_off_interest, cash.due_date, (select max(ct.transaction_DATE) from csh_write_off wo, csh_transaction ct where wo.cashflow_id=cash.cashflow_id and ct.transaction_id = wo.csh_transaction_id) max_WRITE_OFF_DATE from con_contract_cashflow cash, csh_write_off w, csh_transaction ct where cash.cashflow_id = w.cashflow_id and ct.transaction_id = w.csh_transaction_id /*AND CT.Transaction_Type = 'RECEIPT' and ct.business_type = 'RECEIPT'*/ and w.reversed_flag = 'N' AND w.write_off_id = #{writeOffId} ) t
